title: Quantum skyrmion parallelism via metasurface-tailored high-dimensional entanglement
summary: Quantum skyrmions are topological structures that have garnered significant interest due to their demonstrated robustness and versatility across diverse optical platforms. However, existing approaches for their generation are limited to producing pre-determined two dimensional qubit states with a single topology.
